_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Spiller Ëmgéigend op engem {width}x{height} Gitter.
Dir sidd Spiller {player_id}. Gültig Zich: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' oder w/s/a/d.
Zil: iwwerliewe jiddereen aneren. Spueren sinn déidlech; Wandtreffer maachen ëmbréngen; Frontalkollisiounen maachen déi zwee ëm.

game_action.invalid_death: De Spiller {player_id} ass wéinst engem ongültege Schrëtt gestuerwen.

outcome.survived_win: De Spiller {player_id} huet iwwerlieft; all déi aner si gefall.
outcome.outlived: De Spiller huet all déi aner iwwerlieft.
outcome.turn_limit: D'Récklimit ass erreecht - dee längsten iwwerliewt gewënnt.
